pr_title: Update the way that the maximum vector dimension is configured.
pr_body:
The maximum supported dimension used to be configured on the FieldType, it's now on the codec.

Closes #98747.
pr_comments: Thanks Mayya! I think we should simply bump the constant if we want to increase the limit?

issue_context.title: [Lucene-9.8-SNAPSHOT] Update vector size limit override
issue_context.body:
Lucene 9.8 updates the vector dimension limit overridability. Moving it to the codec. 

We should switch our override to do this correctly now, instead of returning a `FieldType` overriding the value.

For now, this commit would belong in the `lucene_snapshot` branch.

review_comments:
In 8.11 (or 8.12), we want to increase MAX_DIMS_COUNT to 4096.  Will we need to create a new KnnVectorsFormat for that?

If an index was created in 8.10 where MAX_DIMS_COUNT to 2048, and then later (say in 8.12) wants to add a new knn field with dims > 2048 (where it will be allowed), should we allow it?
No need to create a new format, we can simply bump the constant from 2048 to 4096. I think we should allow existing indexes to have more than 2048 dimensions too indeed.
